rows.name: Copenhagen Plank
rows.tips: 20 secondes par côté. Cheville sur banc, corps aligné, adducteurs actifs.

rows.name: Inverted Row
rows.tips: Set up a bar at waist height or use a suspension trainer.. Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer, with your feet shoulder-width apart.

rows.name: Romanian Deadlift
rows.tips: Haltères ou barre · charnière hanche · dos neutre

rows.name: Barbell Close-Grip Bench Press
rows.tips: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.. Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.

rows.name: Lying Leg Curl
rows.tips: Machine · tempo 2-0-1 · hanche à plat · pas de rebond

rows.name: Hammer Curl
rows.tips: Prise neutre · pas de balancier · tempo 2-0-1

rows.name: Leg Curl
rows.tips: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/exercises/Seated_Leg_Curl/1.jpg

rows.name: Back Squat
rows.tips: Profondeur complète · genoux sur orteils · chest up

rows.name: Box Jump
rows.tips: Sauts explosifs. Reset entre chaque rep, pas de rebond.

rows.name: Zone-2 (vélo/rameur)
rows.tips: FC 60-70% max. Rythme conversationnel : tu dois pouvoir parler sans t'essouffler.

rows.name: Dips
rows.tips: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/exercises/Dips_-_Chest_Version/1.jpg

rows.name: Deep Barbell Squat
rows.tips: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes slightly turned out.. Hold the barbell behind your legs, resting it on your upper thighs.

rows.name: Seated Cable Row
rows.tips: Câble bas · poignée neutre · squeeze omoplate

rows.name: Cable Seated Row
rows.tips: Câble bas · poignée neutre · squeeze omoplate

rows.name: Barbell Front Squat
rows.tips: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.. Hold the barbell in front of your shoulders, resting it on your collarbone and shoulders.

rows.name: Intervalles (VO2)
rows.tips: 8 rounds : 30s à fond (VO2 max), 90s récup active. La récup complète est aussi importante que l'effort.

rows.name: Deadlift
rows.tips: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/exercises/Barbell_Deadlift/1.jpg

rows.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
rows.tips: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.. Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.

rows.name: Jump Squat
rows.tips: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.

rows.name: Barbell Row
rows.tips: Penché avant · pronation · coudes serrés

rows.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
rows.tips: Pied arrière surélevé · 10 reps/jambe · tronc droit

rows.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
rows.tips: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.. Bend forward at the hips while keeping your back straight and chest up.

rows.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
rows.tips: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.

rows.name: Hanging Leg Raise
rows.tips: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.. Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.

rows.name: Hack Squat
rows.tips: Machine · pieds bas serrés · focus quad

rows.name: Cossack Squat
rows.tips: Talons au sol, jambe tendue orteils au plafond, torse droit, descente profonde.

rows.name: Single-Arm DB Row
rows.tips: Genou sur banc · coude au ciel · 10/côté

rows.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
rows.tips: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.. Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.

rows.name: 90/90 Hip + Band Shoulder Rotation
rows.tips: Assis 90/90, alterne côté à mi-durée. Bande légère pour rotations d'épaules.

rows.name: Seated Leg Curl
rows.tips: Machine · hanche fléchie = plus de stretch ischio · descente lente

rows.name: Face Pull
rows.tips: Câble · corde · hauteur yeux · rotation externe

rows.name: World's Greatest Stretch
rows.tips: 5 répétitions par côté, alternées. Fente + rotation thoracique.

rows.name: Leg Press
rows.tips: Pieds mi-hauteur · amplitude sans verrouiller

rows.name: Barbell Good Morning
rows.tips: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper back.. Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, pushing your buttocks back as if you were trying to touch the wall behind you with your glutes.

rows.name: Barbell Lunge
rows.tips: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.. Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.

rows.name: Walking Lunges
rows.tips: 12 pas/jambe · tronc droit · genou avant sur orteil
